description: Land Title Settlement Department - Haragama, Kandy four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320289
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and legal status of land titles, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
